description: This file defines the 'ThingModified' event class, which is part of an event-driven architecture for a system managing 'things'. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about how the event relates to 'Thing' objects, including handling headers, revision, timestamp, and metadata.

classes.name: ThingModified
classes.description: Implements an event indicating a 'Thing' was modified, with capabilities to create instances from JSON, manipulate revision and headers, and serialize to JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new 'ThingModified' event with specified 'Thing', revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingModified' instance from a JSON string or JSON object, using the provided headers.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' associated with this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new 'ThingModified' instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new 'ThingModified' instance with updated headers.
